title: While the list loads, the Inactive tab never says "No inactive terms"
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • Scenario: Your shop has switched off at least one term, and you open the Inactive tab before the list has loaded.
  • You are an Admin user working at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • At least one term is deactivated.
  • Starting screen: the Settings page.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click "Credit Terms".
  2. Click the "Inactive" tab as soon as it can be clicked, before the rows appear.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the page starts loading.
  • Step 2: while the rows are still loading, the line "No inactive terms" does not show at any moment; once loaded, the inactive terms appear.

A manual tester can try step 2, but on a fast connection the loading moment is too short to judge; this part needs an automated check with a slowed network.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11670 (Story 1, Credit Terms page and list)

  • S1-E3: “While the list is loading, neither tab shows the "No inactive terms" line.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Default Credit Terms" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2erYxWz2ffDNcoXzEfu6wf): canvas pages "1 List and row menus", "3 New credit term and Inactive tab", "4 Everything deactivated and an empty tab" (the pages the PRD names for this story). The design (read in full on 23 Oct 2026) does not draw this case's screen or state, so no design picture is attached; the expected results above come from the PRD.

AUTOMATION: HOLD - a manual tester cannot hold the list in its loading state long enough to look (it needs a slowed network)
